# Northwest Bail Bonds

Northwest Bail Bonds is a Billings-based bail bond company serving all 56 Montana counties. The direct phone line, (406) 601-1225, is answered 24 hours a day.

## Verified contact and coverage facts

- Phone: +1-406-601-1225
- Email: northwestbailbond@gmail.com
- Home base: Billings, Montana
- Service area: Montana statewide, all 56 counties
- Availability: 24 hours a day, seven days a week
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Northwest-Bail-Bonds-LLC-100063740815259/

## Information boundaries

Northwest Bail Bonds can explain the bail bond agreement and process. It does not provide legal advice, guarantee an exact release time, guarantee a legal outcome, or make a case-specific eligibility decision through the website. Facility procedures and custody information can change; official jail, sheriff, court, and government sources are linked from the relevant guides.
